quotes.text: The important thing is not to stop questioning. Curiosity has its own reason for existing.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: We are all agreed that your theory is crazy. The question that divides us is whether it is crazy enough to have a chance of being correct.
quotes.author: Niels Bohr

quotes.text: The universe is not only queerer than we suppose, but queerer than we can suppose.
quotes.author: J.B.S. Haldane

quotes.text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin

quotes.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Compounding curiosity is the most powerful force in intellectual growth.
quotes.author: Harshith Vankela

quotes.text: Ideas compound when they're in the open. Share early, iterate often.
quotes.author: Harshith Vankela
